GENERATE BURST K7-H2-foundry — Hades-language variant of the E07V F03 scene in register H2 (heavy ink contour + cel two-tone), plate only (a matted character is composited afterwards). task_id "K7-H2-foundry".

Deliver EXACTLY ONE image, one image_gen call, LANDSCAPE. Name: out/k7_H2_foundry.png. NO retries: one call; calls_used must equal 1. Image 1 is the LAYOUT reference only.

DESCRIPTION (use it verbatim as the content of the call):
Keeper of Hours — HADES-LANGUAGE SCENE PLATE, register H2. LANDSCAPE 1536×1024. Image 1 is a LAYOUT reference: the F03 FOUNDRY: a brick-and-iron industrial hall — furnace mouth glowing at the upper-left, hanging chain hoist with a suspended crate, an ore cart on rails, a timber workbench under a lantern, stacked crates and barrels, a great riveted pipe crossing the lower-right, an iron gate at the right edge. Hades-language re-imagining: the same hall as a single tight ARENA seen from a STEEP elevated camera (about 60°, looking well down), the floor an inlaid pattern of iron plates and brass rivet-rings in bold geometric bands; saturated jewel-toned light — molten ORANGE from the furnace, TEAL from gas lamps on the pillars, a violet glow from the gate seams; strong graphic shadows; heavy dark chains framing the edges. SCALE ANCHORS: the doorway/gate is two men tall, the workbench/plinth is waist-high, the floor pattern's bands are one stride wide — the room is built for a standing figure about one-sixth of the frame height. NO characters, NO creatures, NO text, NO UI. Register: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D — bold inked contour of even, heavy weight around the silhouette with thinner interior lines, cel-style two-tone shading with painterly texture inside the flats, strong graphic silhouette; a frame that could sit inside a hand-animated cycle with slight drawing variation between frames. The floor is the play surface and fills the lower two-thirds of the frame. Light: key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, dark low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black. Fill the whole canvas; no border, no vignette. Do NOT copy the reference's rendering or brushwork — re-draw the room in this register.

Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/ with the exact name above and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K7-H2-foundry"): images = the file with prompt, references (role + path), elapsed_s; calls_used = 1; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything you could not honour. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: LAYOUT reference (our own E07V F03 scene panel): same room, props and camera position, re-drawn in the Hades language and register H2; do not copy its rendering
